chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نَصِيرٍ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ: إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ يَقْطِينَ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ بِرِسَالَةٍ أَسْأَلُكَ الدُّعَاءَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: فِي أَمْرِ الْآخِرَةِ؟ قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى صَدْرِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: ضَمَنْتُ لِعَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينَ أَلَّا تَمَسَّهُ النَّارُ أَبَدًا

translations.en: I said to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'Ali ibn Yaqtin has sent me to you with a message, asking you to supplicate for him.' He said: 'Concerning the hereafter?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'So he placed his hand on his chest, then said: I guarantee for Ali ibn Yaqtin that the fire will never touch him, ever.'

en.summary: This narration from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights the intercessory power of Imam al-Rida (AS) for Ali ibn Yaqtin, a prominent companion known for his piety and role in transmitting hadith. The Imam’s gesture of placing his hand on his chest signifies a personal, heartfelt guarantee of salvation, emphasizing the Shia belief in the efficacy of the Imams' prayers for the faithful. This specific assurance of protection from the Fire underscores the concept of *al-Kafalah* (guarantee) in Shia theology, where the Imams act as spiritual guarantors for their followers.
en.seo_question: What did the Imam guarantee for Ali ibn Yaqtin regarding the hereafter?

key_terms.أَمْرِ الْآخِرَةِ: the hereafter / affairs of the afterlife
key_terms.أَلَّا تَمَسَّهُ النَّارُ: that the fire will not touch him
